event.title: Trump Prohibits Three Media Outlets from White House Access
event.canonical_title: Trump Prohibits Three Media Outlets from White House Access
event.summary: Trump has banned three media outlets from accessing the White House, marking a continuation of his contentious relationship with the press. This move is seen as part of his broader strategy to target media he views as unfavorable to his administration.

timeline.title: Media Outlets Sue Over Denied White House Access, Citing First Amendment Rights
timeline.summary: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico have filed a lawsuit against the White House, claiming they were denied access to press events. The lawsuit argues that this denial infringes upon their First Amendment rights. This legal action is seen as part of ongoing tensions between the media and the Trump administration regarding press coverage.
key_facts: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are suing the White House.
